_about: Neo4j backend. Copy to neo4j.local.json and adjust; *.local.json is git-ignored.
The password is read from the environment variable named by neo4j_password_env
(default NEO4J_PASSWORD) unless vars.neo4j_password is set. Never commit a password.
project_twin is the SQLite project the parity evals compare against: index the same
working copy twice, once with graph_db and once without (see cases/neo4j/N08_parity.json).
